## Purpose

This document collects the out-of-boundary documentation updates identified during the issue pass starting after <issue id="e6d2c25b-fc24-4858-a08e-54d7e9603e8d">SPE-185</issue>. These are prompts for docs that are not currently editable inside the Containment Protocol project-document boundary.

## Follow-up prompts

* <issue id="ab7184a7-59da-41ad-8cb0-538010881b57">SPE-186</issue> — Update the site/shell architecture doc to state that room identity is not geometry-bound: rooms can change operational role, clue output, occupancy meaning, and route behavior while preserving the base shell, and hidden retrofits can create concealed subspaces or traversal edges discoverable through environmental contradictions.
* <issue id="36f7805b-80b2-48c2-a714-6c3c1cb2ac9b">SPE-188</issue> — Update the civic/governance design doc to state that legal systems may claim formal equality while producing deterministic unequal outcomes based on access to expertise, rank, or precedent; public ordeals, rhetorical contests, reprieve-by-service, and outsider-specific procedure are first-class justice paths.
* <issue id="b1f839aa-c9c5-4e16-ae30-b808d6e250b9">SPE-189</issue> — Update the information-access / command-knowledge doc to distinguish clearance from granted access, classify information by sensitivity and compartment separately, support deliberate absence/redaction as a real state, and document decontrol/declassification and auditable consultation workflows.
* <issue id="d428085b-cd9e-4735-a08b-cda0a2766536">SPE-190</issue> — Update the world-rules / calendar-state doc to state that celestial cycles are deterministic schedule inputs that can unlock rites, alter sacred-site behavior, emit bounded omen signals, and temporarily override faction discipline, alliance, or hostility.
* <issue id="b5a8da9e-0384-4a48-a33f-84c301262947">SPE-191</issue> — Update the team/campaign architecture doc to define a first-class company object with shared purpose, origin, membership logic, and persistent group state distinct from individual actor records, and document which downstream systems read company state versus operator state.
* <issue id="b7f5162b-9eba-4ab3-987a-1bf363d6ae01">SPE-192</issue> — Update the cohesion/support systems doc to define a compact party-level bond resource with deterministic gain, spend, depletion, and recovery rules, separate from health, morale, and action budgets, and specify which outcomes can consume or rebuild it.
* <issue id="c6e65cd9-c4ad-480e-9333-c45926db83ed">SPE-193</issue> — Update the identity/communication/evidence docs to separate spoken fluency from reading and writing fluency, support partial intelligibility, literacy-gated evidence, translation dependency, impossible or specialist scripts, register-sensitive communication, and language-driven access or legitimacy changes.
* <issue id="860a3025-9290-433f-b78e-00270fb41ef8">SPE-194</issue> — Update the population-generation doc to define lifecycle metadata as bounded plausibility weights: identity-specific age bands, retirement tendencies, and operational life stages should influence generation and authored records without hard-locking exceptional cases.
* <issue id="b8a66a85-bc02-40a4-8ffa-5cd4ea6cd654">SPE-195</issue> — Update the recovery/preparation doc to state that rest-phase actions may generate a temporary foresight resource with explicit expiry and deterministic downstream spend, so rest can create bounded predictive leverage rather than only restoring depleted state.
* <issue id="85f9d1a4-5f90-4eb7-b1dd-6918e9b06702">SPE-196</issue> — Update the identity/progression capability doc to define bounded subsystem borrowing: perks can grant narrow, inspectable slices of another capability family, extend an already-owned subsystem differently from first access, and resolve overlap/conflict without collapsing into general multiclassing.
* <issue id="69906c2e-6e96-4ffc-ad75-0a1ae60e793c">SPE-197</issue> — Update the social-access / legitimacy doc to define authored baseline stance between identity pairs as separate from runtime relationship change, with local context modulating but not erasing the default.
* <issue id="2c8ee86f-2a90-4227-b70d-9beaf569e32c">SPE-198</issue> — Update the NPC/population generation doc to define a staged region-first pipeline: resolve macro-region first, then local anchor, then social/vocational/personality detail; keep each stage inspectable, allow deferred capability reveal within consistency bounds, and let site/biome/faction context swap in role lists and inhabitant pools.
* <issue id="c1933792-7491-4d06-8d41-90ce2f1fc0ab">SPE-199</issue> — Update the vocation generation doc to define expertise-domain-first routing, where broad competence domains branch into several professions under explicit local-demand and origin constraints.
* <issue id="34989d60-aae8-4d32-83e0-8713df06f7fb">SPE-200</issue> — Update the actor generation doc to define late rare overlays as additive packets applied after ordinary generation, preserving origin, profession, and placement while adding exceptional status, hooks, or capability under explicit rarity rules.
* <issue id="a0415f06-6f5a-4d00-9a96-f34a3b6c3b79">SPE-201</issue> — Update the actor-generation doc to separate motive, interest, and presentation into distinct layers, support archetype seeds and low-cost stock-role templates, allow multi-role composition and later promotion into fuller actors, and keep burden-forward or socially risky identities explicit rather than cosmetic.
* <issue id="38b57414-7595-49c6-9856-8c847ac0c9fc">SPE-202</issue> — Update the population-generation doc to define a rapid NPC seeding path that emits compact grounded packets with motive, rumor, weirdness, local anchor, and role clarity, and supports later expansion into fuller records without continuity break.
* <issue id="ee6a7dc3-2090-4796-a86c-1f3be1f76dbe">SPE-203</issue> — Update the design-review doc to define thematic coherence review as an explicit cross-layer check against target experience, including mechanics, UI, pacing, encounter structure, presentation mood, and visible human cost.
* <issue id="2b1479e0-8616-4f20-8297-85e991f98ab0">SPE-204</issue> — Update the identity-expression review doc to check whether claimed avatar identity matches what the player actually gets to perceive, decide, and feel in play, including proxy cases with bounded perspective and local tact/personality variance.
* <issue id="20109c2c-fabe-40b6-b6a1-1482a2ad7bb3">SPE-205</issue> — Update the encounter/interaction design doc to state that important traits should be expressed through player action where feasible—timing, interpretation, planning, or judgment—while remaining bounded so not every trait becomes a pure execution challenge.
* <issue id="a4e08f12-3c24-4aaf-92e6-f98766ee9826">SPE-206</issue> — Update the scene-authoring doc to define scaffolded set pieces as bounded guidance packets combining learned verbs, foreshadowing, danger framing, and objective logic.
* <issue id="5a45d828-fb0a-4884-bfc8-db351d20971e">SPE-207</issue> — Update the narrative systems doc to separate simulation truth from narrative framing, support mixed-tone prompts, backstory-to-arc linkage, multi-perspective reporting, meaning construction through reveal order, culturally contingent labels, and conspiracy-style explanatory linking without changing underlying event truth.
* <issue id="f442841b-cde3-4865-8f9b-2419cbeada61">SPE-208</issue> — Update the relationship systems doc to define bond emergence from cooperation, separation, rescue, neglect, betrayal, memory exchange, and reunion; support non-restorative aftermath, protective falsehoods, enduring relationship tokens, scaled consequence propagation by actor importance, and long-horizon trajectory states beyond romance.
* <issue id="b0e7cff3-d26a-4719-8c82-0d7f76a675b0">SPE-209</issue> — Update the hazard-authoring doc to define relationship-testing hazards whose key outputs are trust strain, burden-sharing, jealousy-skewed judgment, loyalty distortion, nonlethal hospitality traps, or cooperation failure.
* <issue id="e9a5ccf9-ff13-4e57-aafd-760c50ba104e">SPE-210</issue> — Update the event-generation doc to define low-repeatability levers for high-value moments, using rare combinations of state, place, actor, timing, or knowledge payload.
* <issue id="1dd4c043-6426-4a5b-8c3a-b820644f5d54">SPE-211</issue> — Update the travel/survival doc to define climate and terrain as operational state: route degradation, forecasting uncertainty, structured overland actions, loadout-sensitive survival, logistics denial, graded visibility, terrain-cell semantics, post-disaster survival phases, and survival burdens.
* <issue id="f4c8d04c-c2e8-48f9-926e-03765ea1ddb3">SPE-212</issue> — Update the faction/culture doc to define intraculture splits as real internal models with rival doctrine, ritual alignment, reform stance, trade posture, imposed labels, and mythic justifications.
* <issue id="c7761ab8-3430-4a67-b0eb-7259398f953a">SPE-213</issue> — Update the identity/social-origin doc to define violence-linked maturation as a bounded eligibility/status track, with explicit completion, failure, avoidance, or deferment states.
* <issue id="f528f635-4c3e-4ef1-85fb-faf5d78c7d5d">SPE-214</issue> — Update the institution/site doc to define worship infrastructure as more than public temples: hidden shrines, seasonal activation windows, mobile clergy, taboo zones, and sacred places that directly modify legal, amplified, blocked, or punished actions.
* <issue id="c748db13-247b-475a-b85f-7fe5dc680f72">SPE-215</issue> — Update the combat/behavior-state doc to define ferocity as a precommitted state with narrowed control, altered target logic, equipment or action constraints, and persistent aftermath burden.
* <issue id="b88f9a0d-bc5c-44ab-aea3-64db464c5533">SPE-216</issue> — Update the item-runtime / identity-media doc to define body-bound media as analyzable by material, pattern, placement, storage state, activation, removal, and audience-specific meaning, including living or quasi-living surface media, pigment consumption, and maintenance burden.
* <issue id="14189eeb-adc2-408f-9991-873ddde8cf57">SPE-217</issue> — Update the governance/economy doc to define concealed sovereign reserves as off-ledger continuity resources with explicit crisis, succession, legitimacy, and depletion rules.
* <issue id="9a28ea97-3696-4644-b199-c79505d816e9">SPE-218</issue> — Update the coastal-site / logistics doc to define hidden bases whose access depends on environmental windows such as tide, fog, or weather, with deception depth and secondary concealed ingress.
* <issue id="afa2da8f-8d38-44b9-a4dd-e798189faa19">SPE-219</issue> — Update the criminal-organization doc to define coercive membership as a tracked no-exit state where apparent voluntariness at entry does not reduce later coercion.
* <issue id="db4f1e80-eaa2-4778-adfb-e1b1f22e5640">SPE-220</issue> — Update the covert-action / political-force doc to define leased-force deniability through sponsor traceability, attribution-confidence ladders, private confirmation with public denial, explanatory shields, misidentification risk, and bounded ambiguity.
* <issue id="e97087a2-5ba2-470c-81bb-cf0bb599dbfb">SPE-221</issue> — Update the legitimacy/taboo-response doc to define hidden capability, suspected capability, and confirmed public revelation as separate states, and document how stigma-driven exposure can collapse loyalty, support, and public order.
* <issue id="d3fa9dc9-8f56-4975-ad7b-1038964e33b7">SPE-222</issue> — Update the governance-control doc to define dual-rule packets where symbolic apex authority and practical regency split holdings, policy, fiscal power, and enforcement.
* <issue id="59e5c84f-fa0c-4b83-9c73-7c24ff064f0c">SPE-223</issue> — Update the region/corruption doc to define overlapping-reality woodland zones as authored territory properties with overlap class, corruption intensity, traversal effects, and access filtering.
* <issue id="bfa7d0be-6e61-4e01-b2e3-956b5630798e">SPE-224</issue> — Update the ecology/ambush doc to define vibration-sensing subsurface predators with below-cover pursuit, false-safe terrain states, coordinated emergence, and altered encounter geometry.
* <issue id="3aca6c8a-2608-4cd1-b749-de35844440fa">SPE-225</issue> — Update the portal/anomaly doc to define gate payloads as reusable side-effect packets keyed to transit state or route class, with trait-sensitive targeting and deterministic countermeasure matrices.
* <issue id="0d07a194-6e97-4532-bfe7-2b34495ed675">SPE-226</issue> — Update the regional-generation doc to define band-based habitability, where narrow survivable strips between hostile extremes shape settlement logic, route pressure, ecology, and edge-condition variation.
* <issue id="e6ddd213-8f5b-458c-a3b0-013f2963139f">SPE-227</issue> — Update the world-law / timing doc to define stable local time, drifting local time, and unreadable time states, and document how route planning, ritual timing, watchkeeping, and schedule confidence degrade when celestial reference is absent or distorted.
* <issue id="c5324889-e3e0-4a93-9e6b-49f3adb338ed">SPE-228</issue> — Update the hazard/containment doc to define portable toxin media with explicit storage-safe, active-release, and spent/degraded states, including persistence changes from containment quality, environment, and deployment method.
* <issue id="710017cc-04ab-468a-b83f-309f0cf81d5d">SPE-229</issue> — Update the structural-hazard doc to define heat stress as a staged structural-state system with marginal, overloaded, shifting, cracked, or delayed-failure conditions.
* <issue id="4c26fdb2-4a73-4fa8-ba5c-a783a682c224">SPE-230</issue> — Update the travel-encounter doc to define encounter cadence as multi-axis, driven by route class, local section, density, visibility, time state, threat posture, and event-category weighting.
* <issue id="474f8ced-2287-419f-aae2-0d4aee461079">SPE-231</issue> — Update the vehicle-control doc to define fixed-contact embodied helm states that replace ordinary personal agency, expose vehicle orientation and envelope state through the operator, support multi-role crew competency, operator-loss drift, contested succession over bonded control seats, and shared helm dependency.
* <issue id="46e8665f-6af9-4039-b6fd-583e2dc946b5">SPE-232</issue> — Update the atmosphere/life-support doc to define atmosphere as an active tracked layer with composition, humidity, pressure, fouling, decay, occupancy-sensitive consumption, transfer on contact, staged exposure clocks, portable life-support dependence, and pre-emergence atmospheric telegraphing.
* <issue id="d0d29655-c458-4b2e-8005-90f57d94b956">SPE-233</issue> — Update the local-physics doc to define geometry-based gravity planes, orientation-boundary traversal, dominant-field takeover on contact, and drift/capture behavior under sub-threshold high-speed interaction.
* <issue id="4be0d810-aa56-4d1d-ba81-69debf36b35f">SPE-234</issue> — Update the ability-legality doc to define environment-taxonomy gating for tools and powers, including hard illegality, degraded reliability, null-action states, local-compatible substitution, provenance-sensitive compatibility, false mundanity, false-key sabotage, and narrow protective gear.
* <issue id="9e580ddb-69f4-4f41-b319-7ea1b8b82d22">SPE-235</issue> — Update the patron-access doc to define location-sensitive recognition, hard denial, throttling ceilings, partial fallback through allied equivalence or temporary restored contact, and jurisdiction-based power degradation.
* <issue id="b23638fd-e684-4125-80f9-44ffbfd2766d">SPE-236</issue> — Update the vehicle-propulsion doc to define temporary control and propulsion assets as bounded, short-duration infrastructure packets.
* <issue id="87326dee-d93d-4184-9cbc-c548d9ce95cd">SPE-237</issue> — Update the propulsion architecture doc to define heterogeneous engine classes and helm types, including seat-locked, pooled, consumptive, biological, artifact-bound, industrial, temporary, and salvage-built mixed-origin configurations.
* <issue id="32a4c646-a46c-4f5a-9966-186f506f074e">SPE-238</issue> — Update the control-interface doc to define wearable bonded remote control as distinct from seat-locked control, with explicit range, bond, line, timing, latency, shared-action-budget, override, and loadout constraints.
* <issue id="b8d778a7-a04d-473e-aa10-c103277f7e23">SPE-239</issue> — Update the propulsion-cost doc to define biological engines powered by bound living subjects, including escalating drain, healing suppression, subject-condition thresholds, death-risk, and legitimacy/captivity burden.
* <issue id="461bde70-0b56-46f6-8e5a-5f4d262d0f72">SPE-240</issue> — Update the power-core doc to distinguish burn cores that consume inventory-like objects for temporary output from bound-object cores that socket singular high-value artifacts for persistent output with ongoing risk, governance cost, multi-system dependency, and missing-core clue surfaces.
* <issue id="0e6ee7e4-2e3e-402d-ad6b-73c6a8d6a9e5">SPE-241</issue> — Update the breach-transit doc to define deliberate boundary openings, stabilized breach replication, breach-search tooling, formation-integrity transfer requirements, finite transit budgets, and asymmetric navigator-controlled routing.
* <issue id="37013e32-8d6c-4f19-b863-228e19d900d0">SPE-242</issue> — Update the entity-presentation doc to define presentation overlays as separable from internal rule packages, with appearance, clothing, bearing, gear display, and speech acting as socially legible status surfaces while mechanical identity remains learnable.
* <issue id="66880e78-ce55-49bc-8839-2be6d4cdf081">SPE-243</issue> — Update the ecology/adaptation doc to define reusable environment templates, mutation overlays, age-stage combinations, skill adaptation under hostile environments, pressure-shaped drift, and bounded novelty as modifications to baseline families.
* <issue id="16e73599-e5fe-4768-8da5-c0609b48adf0">SPE-244</issue> — Update the survival-response doc to define environmental interventions as breathable-air refresh, retention fields, cocoon-style preservation, and low-output survival stances that reduce resource burn while preserving residual risk.
* <issue id="6266cbbb-097b-4142-a5ac-ad4593139383">SPE-245</issue> — Update the structural-effects doc to define material-sensitive repair, sabotage, fabrication, transmutation, controlled disintegration, compression-for-release, bond strengthening/weakening, and breach creation as conversions of existing substrate.
* <issue id="e9e305f2-c7ba-4c01-8a11-2d53ce9bc831">SPE-246</issue> — Update the vehicle-weapon doc to define linked-operator composite beam systems where several operators merge abilities into one directed large-scale effect under explicit geometry and composition rules.
* <issue id="b09221cf-83ae-48a1-87e0-fc4a9784969e">SPE-247</issue> — Update the vehicle-damage doc to define subsystem-critical vehicle damage, including control shock, atmosphere failure, weapon disablement, drift, emergency dive, and colossal-body subsystem-only vulnerability.
* <issue id="6bb12211-ec4b-4a19-8066-09942e09e037">SPE-248</issue> — Update the close-contact vehicle combat doc to define ramming, grappling, boarding, towing, netting, and shearing as distinct tactical modes with geometry and manpower implications.
* <issue id="adb80b01-d970-457b-908e-948c938c980e">SPE-249</issue> — Update the persistent obstacle doc to define magical barriers and hazards as world objects with collision, navigation, salvage, trap, and accretion-cocoon implications rather than short-lived combat visuals.
* <issue id="a9e90deb-56e6-494c-bc99-288770a2fb35">SPE-250</issue> — Update the mobile-habitat doc to define moving assets as transport, settlement, industry, spectacle, covert route, and later ruin or hostile site across explicit lifecycle phases.
* <issue id="265c1f75-75d7-417b-b8b0-019bab631e66">SPE-251</issue> — Update the remote-sensing doc to define anchored scry/projection through local surfaces or devices, with separate operator, anchor, and target-field states, anti-scry shielding, stored-presence communication, verification workflows, and escalation from observation into reciprocal breach risk.
* <issue id="f2d5f448-cd0d-4409-b3f0-3f626d8aeb98">SPE-252</issue> — Update the encounter-presentation doc to require explicit human, architectural, vehicle, or civic scale anchors for giant threats.
* <issue id="dd2da4f4-174b-4244-a02c-ffbb0ef82161">SPE-253</issue> — Update the artifact/wearable doc to define wearable relics as identity-bearing risk objects whose possession, wear-state, defects, activation, removal rules, and custody status can alter pursuit, paranoia, temptation, dependency, social privilege, lethality, and bodily autonomy.
* <issue id="345f3ae7-95ae-45f7-a494-94b68977cbfb">SPE-254</issue> — Update the site-authoring doc to define site-class silhouettes as bounded exterior promises about hazard family, encounter cadence, access rules, and likely hidden-depth.
* <issue id="9fe9f027-c314-475c-acd8-145f10bda457">SPE-255</issue> — Update the content-pipeline doc to define a reusable cross-discipline brief packet that captures mechanics, writing, art, UX, production constraints, shared experiential vocabulary, and explicit resolution of conflicting priorities.
* <issue id="795b7bb2-3077-4622-a76f-6ff004735a7d">SPE-256</issue> — Update the lineage/anomaly doc to define progenitor-driven subtype creation, inherited capability propagation, coexistence of origin and derivative populations, subtype-origin overlays within one ancestry family, and continuity markers such as blood chemistry or residue signature.
* <issue id="d6946c2c-90b3-4f2e-9260-3693093ac464">SPE-257</issue> — Update the territorial-power / artifact doc to define singular siphon artifacts that extract, store, and gate region-linked energy for realm-scale casting.
* <issue id="dc996a25-d4f8-4b2a-ba90-ed69289b8097">SPE-258</issue> — Update the affliction/conversion doc to define delayed postmortem conversion with day-by-day progression, family-specific payloads, healing suppression, bounded onward spread, false-death states, kill-method-dependent outcomes, burial-reactivation risk, and multi-phase cure chains.
* <issue id="887869c1-42e7-4d4b-ab95-1684b15de1c7">SPE-259</issue> — Update the fortification/runtime-object doc to define portable defensive assets that unfold into chokepoint nodes, package anti-assault features and pass-control value, then restore or recompress into item-state.
* <issue id="194a1116-58cf-4a71-80b0-9652ca8359f0">SPE-260</issue> — Update the corruption-field doc to define hidden focal points that produce region-scale spell unreliability, surface symptoms beyond the source room, and family-specific amplification or distortion on one effect axis.
* <issue id="fc73f467-a220-48af-85f7-1365723af0b3">SPE-261</issue> — Update the hidden-site doc to define realm-scale concealment as a persistent site-state with access-conditioned approach, return-denial, extraction failure, misleading boundaries, trap-pocket behavior, and rare exception-return logic.
* <issue id="a859a87d-b156-4083-abda-05a56f3d28b9">SPE-262</issue> — Update the fortification/security doc to define passive anti-intrusion materials and seal classes that block transport, scrying, gaseous ingress, and seep-based entry without active maintenance.
* <issue id="307fc042-339b-409e-9fbd-7f72fa644e99">SPE-263</issue> — Update the hazard-propagation doc to define ignition buildup, warning states, and confined-geometry blast shaping so tunnels, shafts, and narrow corridors channel and amplify explosions differently from open-space rules.
* <issue id="5294969a-41d9-4dc2-aed9-f0161c24c7a7">SPE-264</issue> — Update the environment-layering doc to define altitude/depth bands with distinct breathable, explosive, lethal, and visibility states, split vertical ecologies, mixed-breathability coexistence layers, and altitude-sensitive perception and targeting.
* <issue id="8a773474-25e1-4f08-91b2-621dee413f20">SPE-265</issue> — Update the antagonist-systems doc to define explicit strategic timetables for hostile actors, including proactive objectives, restoration milestones after defeat, retaliation-tier escalation, off-screen progress beats, recurring nemesis continuity, and opportunity-triggered appearance logic.
* <issue id="0dd133c5-00a9-458d-9d76-88d077aef854">SPE-266</issue> — Update the item-anomaly doc to define contact, offering, and ingestion-based object transmutation, with explicit material-class, value-class, and target-class constraints, plus deterministic downgrade or reversal cases and inspectable post-contact object states.
* <issue id="41306a42-7a47-4058-a4fe-d2c5ca0c0f4e">SPE-267</issue> — Update the hostile-ecology doc to define emotion-fed sustain loops where entities provoke fear, humiliation, despair, guilt, grievance, worship, or collective memory states and convert them into healing, persistence, retargeting, or escalation.
* <issue id="1f8dd25d-1e3f-45cf-a3e4-7fa719df4ca5">SPE-268</issue> — Update the construct-runtime doc to define upkeep burden, fault tables, measurable component thresholds, sequence-sensitive maintenance, partial shutdown, rogue drift, and persistent created-actor degradation.
* <issue id="ef55ee2c-779d-491c-9a81-b066e1fbf9ad">SPE-269</issue> — Update the host-conversion doc to define implanted or attached parasite cores that progress through visible deterministic stages, including neurochemical overwrite, deep anchor sites, extraction lethality, antagonistic co-infection, delayed drain, direct-transfer paths, and rescue/evacuation moments as peak spread windows.
* <issue id="622f6b00-6c89-4aa2-802d-3ec7b2b16777">SPE-270</issue> — Update the drain-effects doc to define dual-resource attacks that steal biological reserve and memory/identity payloads together, distinguish live reserve theft from latent-potential extraction and sedation-linked vulnerability, and support delayed remote transfer, reservoir storage, survivor-only recovery windows, and typed subsystem loss.
* <issue id="6562205e-ae90-40e5-900e-8142864e26f0">SPE-271</issue> — Update the defensive-interaction doc to define geometry-sensitive spell reflection by angle, surface orientation, and return path, and document how reflection, absorption, blocking, dismissal, and similar anti-magic defenses compete through explicit precedence and compatibility rules.
* <issue id="96e1a3f5-0972-4e7d-acaf-3232ca1038a3">SPE-272</issue> — Update the anomaly-geometry doc to define distributed multi-node actors as coherent linked patterns whose internal geometry persists across scale changes, distinct from vehicles, single oversized bodies, or unstructured swarms.
* <issue id="ecca1cb0-9534-41d6-8864-44f3282748e9">SPE-273</issue> — Update the encounter-geometry doc to define attack, binding, and imprisonment through large spatial arrangements, with occupancy, escape, and confinement consequences derived from pattern state.
* <issue id="72db2c9b-2942-4acb-8c26-a85b7065bdf3">SPE-274</issue> — Update the concealment/mimic doc to define terrain-matching shell states, projected appendage attacks, angle- and contrast-dependent readability, reveal/collapse transitions, and post-defeat follow-through hazards.
* <issue id="1ec8c6da-0ce2-4298-b9e7-d95884ba84aa">SPE-275</issue> — Update the preparation/cognition-resource doc to define direct neural theft of prepared or staged abilities, including bounded thief usability, victim-side loss state, thief-side acquisition state, later recovery surfaces, and risky activation of foreign procedures outside native specialty.
* <issue id="8074e5cd-5a6f-4cf7-aa53-32f62a00295e">SPE-276</issue> — Update the actor-runtime doc to define phase-conditioned state machines driven by moon phase, eclipse, season-light interaction, or thresholded environmental triggers, including reversible restraint, timed reactivation, and explicit profile switching.
* <issue id="1e14ef8c-2164-4d39-a8d5-4f653ccb9580">SPE-277</issue> — Update the apex-behavior / cognition-resource doc to define entities that consume knowledge, memory, and operational understanding as primary runtime resources, including depth-linked overload, repeat-exposure escalation, and downstream sustain, growth, leverage, or identity-power changes.
* <issue id="fc40aafc-33ee-457a-9208-7a6987f349c2">SPE-278</issue> — Update the vehicle-usability doc to define control and interior compatibility by body plan, posture, size, and species ergonomics, separate from authorization, and expose crew, cargo, route suitability, and transport role in operational summaries.
* <issue id="c7e6b3af-4b3b-4613-9927-cf2ffbcc1853">SPE-279</issue> — Update the large-entity representation doc to define oversized distributed actors as single coherent entities whose footprint exceeds ordinary token assumptions.
* <issue id="d4fa400f-da00-471e-8ef4-675bcfc685e4">SPE-280</issue> — Update the campaign-transition doc to define offsite migration as a bounded continuity packet that preserves actors, obligations, resources, world state, and inherited site liabilities while converting suitable resolved sites into annexes, staging houses, depots, safehouses, or field offices.
